statements.status_notes: RUSTSEC-2024-0449 reports that unsafe-libyaml is archived and unmaintained after its c2rust translation of libyaml, with no patched releases beyond 0.2.11. Milvus ships it transitively through serde_yaml in the embedded Tantivy binding Cargo graph compiled into the milvus Debian packages this image installs. Replacing it requires upstream dependency migrations to a maintained safe-Rust YAML stack and a package rebuild; that work remains under evaluation. See https://rustsec.org/advisories/RUSTSEC-2024-0449.html
